selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Shows UFW activation, persisted REJECT policy, explicit IPv4/IPv6 allows for TCP 22 and 8080, successful SSH/8080 traffic, rejected TCP 9090 traffic, and corresponding packet counters.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence both show Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Shows healthy pre-restart state and boot ID 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45, acknowledged restart scheduling, changed boot ID 8c001778-757d-411a-b748-213bc3030454, recovered UFW/SSH services and rules, successful post-restart live traffic tests, and final healthy system state.

commands.command:
set -u
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind "$NODE_IP" >/tmp/fw-8080.log 2>&1 & p8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind "$NODE_IP" >/tmp/fw-9090.log 2>&1 & p9090=$!
cleanup() { kill "$p8080" "$p9090" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$p8080" "$p9090" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '--- listener proof ---'; ss -lntp | grep -E ':8080|:9090'
printf '%s\n' '--- SSH permitted path ---'; ssh-keyscan -T 3 "$NODE_IP" 2>&1 | sed -n '1,4p'; ssh_rc=${PIPESTATUS:-0}
printf '%s\n' '--- TCP 8080 permitted path ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP_8080=%{http_code}\n' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"; rc8080=$?
printf '%s\n' '--- unrelated TCP 9090 rejected path ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP_9090=%{http_code}\n' "http://$NODE_IP:9090/"; rc9090=$?
printf 'RESULT rc8080=%s rc9090=%s\n' "$rc8080" "$rc9090"
[ "$rc8080" -eq 0 ] && [ "$rc9090" -ne 0 ]

commands.command:
set -u
ns=ufw-postrestart
ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true
ip link del ufw-post-host 2>/dev/null || true
ip netns add "$ns"
ip link add ufw-post-host type veth peer name ufw-post-peer
ip link set ufw-post-peer netns "$ns"
ip addr add 198.51.100.1/30 dev ufw-post-host
ip link set ufw-post-host up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip addr add 198.51.100.2/30 dev ufw-post-peer
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set ufw-post-peer up
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/ufw-post-8080.log 2>&1 & p8080=$!
python3 -m http.server 9090 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/ufw-post-9090.log 2>&1 & p9090=$!
cleanup() { kill "$p8080" "$p9090" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$p8080" "$p9090" 2>/dev/null || true; ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true; ip link del ufw-post-host 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
sleep 1
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart independent source and listeners ---'; ip netns exec "$ns" ip -4 -br addr; ss -lntp | grep -E ':22|:8080|:9090'
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart SSH TCP/22 permitted ---'; ip netns exec "$ns" python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('198.51.100.1',22),3); print(s.recv(80).decode().strip()); s.close()"; rc22=$?
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart TCP/8080 permitted ---'; ip netns exec "$ns" curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP_8080=%{http_code}\n' http://198.51.100.1:8080/; rc8080=$?
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart unrelated TCP/9090 rejected despite listener ---'; ip netns exec "$ns" curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 3 -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP_9090=%{http_code}\n' http://198.51.100.1:9090/; rc9090=$?
printf 'RESULT rc22=%s rc8080=%s rc9090=%s\n' "$rc22" "$rc8080" "$rc9090"
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart packet counters ---'; iptables -L ufw-user-input -n -v --line-numbers; iptables -L ufw-reject-input -n -v --line-numbers
[ "$rc22" -eq 0 ] && [ "$rc8080" -eq 0 ] && [ "$rc9090" -ne 0 ]
